newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Henderson to issue 33 mln shares in Tokyo listing.
newsitem.headline: Henderson to issue 33 mln shares in Tokyo listing.

text.p: Henderson Land Development Co Ltd said on Wednesday it would issue 33 million new shares at HK$73.25 per share share as part of a planned secondary listing in Tokyo.

In a statement the company said the new shares, which would represent 1.91 percent of its enlarged issued share capital, would raise net proceeds of about HK$2.35 billion which the company plans to use for general funding purposes.
It said the number of shares had been raised from an initial planned offer of 30 million shares due to investor demand.
The Japan share offer is due to run on Wednesday and Thursday, Henderson said. Dealing in the shares is expected to begin on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on February 5.
Henderson Land shares closed at HK$74.75 in Hong Kong on Tuesday.
